name: standalone ssm:SendCommand (no PassRole) fires COMPUTE-SESSION-TAKEOVER
note: Running a command on an existing EC2 instance executes under the instance's already-attached IAM role - a standalone code-exec / lateral-movement primitive needing no iam:PassRole and no code change. COMPUTE-SESSION-TAKEOVER fires at high.
rationale: ssm:SendCommand runs attacker-supplied commands on an existing instance under that instance's IAM role; it does not attach a new role, so no PassRole path fires. It is a real standalone code-execution primitive (Rhino SSM privesc), so COMPUTE-SESSION-TAKEOVER fires at high (evidence high, exploitability medium: the target instance role's power is out of scope).
